t: You're looking at St Mary's Gardens, an eighteenth-century garden triangle in Lambeth, with an unusual triangular shape. Three rows of houses face a shared green, and they've been Grade II listed since 1981. The whole area has been a Conservation Area since 1968. The Scottish painter Craigie Aitchison died here in 2009. He's best known for his many paintings of the Crucifixion, one of which hangs behind the altar in Liverpool Cathedral's chapter house, as well as Italian landscapes and portraits, all in simple, bright, childlike colours.
